info.title: v2.ads.get_recommended_keyword_list
info.description: Use this API to get the list of Recommended keywords by item and optionally a search keyword

get.description: Use this API to get the list of Recommended keywords by item and optionally a search keyword

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: input_keyword
parameters.description: The keyword seller typed in the manually add keyword window.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an item.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://open.admin.uat.shopee.io/api/v2/ads/get_keyword_rcmd_keyword?access_token=access_token&input_keyword=keyword&item_id=1111&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=12312&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: keyword
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Keyword value (Only return the highly recommended keywords, will be sightly different from Seller Center)

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: quality_score
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is a measure of how attractive your ad is and its relevance to the keyword. The higher the quality score, the higher your ad rank. Ad rank is based on this score and your bid price.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: search_volume
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The number of times the keyword has been searched on Shopee in the last 30 days. The larger the search volume, the more impressions your ad will receive.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: suggested_bid
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is bid price suggested by Shopee algorithm for the keyword in local currency.
